elements.element: Vendor (HDI) defends and indemnifies Customer against third-party claims
elements.evidence: HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company ... from and against any third party claim

elements.element: Coverage: claims alleging the services or deliverables infringe IP
elements.evidence: any allegation that the Site, the services performed by HDI hereunder or any materials, software or technology provided by HDI ... infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right
(b) HDI's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation

elements.element: Coverage: data breach caused by Vendor
elements.evidence: (c) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Content, Confidential Information or user or customer data caused by HDI
(d) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct
shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim

elements.element: Procedure: indemnifying party control of defence
elements.evidence: shall permit the indemnifying Party to control the defense
shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content
elements.evidence: any allegation that the Content or Marks furnished by the Company and used by HDI in accordance with this Agreement infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: or out of the Company's breach of applicable law

elements.element: Vendor IP indemnity with usual exclusions (Customer modifications, combinations, specifications)
elements.evidence: Only carve-out is "(excluding the Content and Marks provided by the Company)"; no modification/combination/specification exclusions

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3× annual fees
elements.evidence: No cap or super-cap language inserted

offending_extra_words: and their respective officers, directors and employees
The Company shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless HDI
provided that no settlement imposing any liability or obligation on, or requiring any admission by, the indemnified Party shall be made without its prior written consent
provided that failure to do so shall relieve the indemnifying Party only to the extent it is materially prejudiced
reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are present: HDI defence/indemnity for the Company and affiliates covering IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, plus notice, control and cooperation, with the Company's reciprocal indemnity confined to Content/Marks it supplies and its own breach of law.

Fallback is not satisfied (no modification/combination/specification exclusions, no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, no 3x super-cap), but the locked target is preferred so this does not matter for compliance.

Strict minimality fails: the insertion adds hold-harmless language, extra indemnitees (officers, directors, employees), a Customer defence duty, and settlement/prejudice mechanics beyond the preferred notice-control-cooperation trio.

Intent is preserved: the existing Section 9(b) Globix carve-out and Section 10 remain untouched, numbering 9A sits before the next heading, and terms used (Content, Marks, Confidential Information, Site) are defined elsewhere in the Agreement.
